opus.problem: Nearly repeats clue 1. Both use the same verse (Matthew 21:9) and both say crowds going into Jerusalem shouted it to the Son of David.

Repeats the shout already covered by clue 5 from the same verse (Mark 11:10), and the entry-road shouting already in clue 1. The quoted phrase "in the highest" also nearly gives the word away, so this clue is easier than medium hard.

The Bible does not give 7 different facts about this word. Every clue comes from just two moments: the crowd's shout at the entry into Jerusalem and the children's shout in the temple. That is why clues 1/4, 5/6 and 2/3 repeat each other. The rules say to swap it for a spare.
